commands.command:
set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-storage >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_STORAGE_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
state_dir=/var/lib/srv-data
origin_file=$state_dir/origin.img
cow_file=$state_dir/snapshot.cow
active_file=$state_dir/snapshot.active
origin_real=srvdata-real
origin_map=srvdata
snapshot_map=srvdata-snap
mount_dir=/srv/data

find_loop() {
    losetup -j "$1" | awk -F: 'NR == 1 { print $1 }'
}

start_storage() {
    modprobe dm_snapshot
    mkdir -p "$state_dir" "$mount_dir"
    test -f "$origin_file"
    origin_loop=$(find_loop "$origin_file")
    if test -z "$origin_loop"; then
        origin_loop=$(losetup --find --show "$origin_file")
    fi
    sectors=$(blockdev --getsz "$origin_loop")
    if ! dmsetup info "$origin_real" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        dmsetup create "$origin_real" --table "0 $sectors linear $origin_loop 0"
    fi
    if ! dmsetup info "$origin_map" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        dmsetup create "$origin_map" --table "0 $sectors snapshot-origin /dev/mapper/$origin_real"
    fi
    if test -f "$active_file" && test -f "$cow_file" && ! dmsetup info "$snapshot_map" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        cow_loop=$(find_loop "$cow_file")
        if test -z "$cow_loop"; then
            cow_loop=$(losetup --find --show "$cow_file")
        fi
        dmsetup create "$snapshot_map" --readonly --table "0 $sectors snapshot /dev/mapper/$origin_real $cow_loop P 8"
    fi
    if ! mountpoint -q "$mount_dir"; then
        mount "/dev/mapper/$origin_map" "$mount_dir"
    fi
}

stop_storage() {
    if mountpoint -q "$mount_dir"; then
        umount "$mount_dir"
    fi
    dmsetup remove "$snapshot_map" 2>/dev/null || true
    dmsetup remove "$origin_map" 2>/dev/null || true
    dmsetup remove "$origin_real" 2>/dev/null || true
    cow_loop=$(find_loop "$cow_file" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if test -n "$cow_loop"; then
        losetup -d "$cow_loop"
    fi
    origin_loop=$(find_loop "$origin_file" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if test -n "$origin_loop"; then
        losetup -d "$origin_loop"
    fi
}

case "${1:-}" in
    start) start_storage ;;
    stop) stop_storage ;;
    *) printf 'usage: %s {start|stop}\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_STORAGE_EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-storage
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-snapshot >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SNAPSHOT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
state_dir=/var/lib/srv-data
cow_file=$state_dir/snapshot.cow
active_file=$state_dir/snapshot.active
origin_real=srvdata-real
origin_map=srvdata
snapshot_map=srvdata-snap
mount_dir=/srv/data

find_loop() {
    losetup -j "$1" | awk -F: 'NR == 1 { print $1 }'
}

create_snapshot() {
    label=${1:-snapshot-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)}
    mountpoint -q "$mount_dir"
    if test -e "$active_file" || dmsetup info "$snapshot_map" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'an active snapshot already exists\n' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    truncate -s 1073741824 "$cow_file"
    cow_loop=$(losetup --find --show "$cow_file")
    sectors=$(blockdev --getsz "/dev/mapper/$origin_real")
    xfs_freeze -f "$mount_dir"
    if ! dmsetup create "$snapshot_map" --readonly --table "0 $sectors snapshot /dev/mapper/$origin_real $cow_loop P 8"; then
        xfs_freeze -u "$mount_dir"
        losetup -d "$cow_loop"
        rm -f "$cow_file"
        exit 1
    fi
    xfs_freeze -u "$mount_dir"
    printf '%s\n' "$label" > "$active_file"
    sync
    printf 'created snapshot %s\n' "$label"
    dmsetup status "$snapshot_map"
}

rollback_snapshot() {
    test -f "$active_file"
    label=$(cat "$active_file")
    cow_loop=$(find_loop "$cow_file")
    test -n "$cow_loop"
    sectors=$(blockdev --getsz "/dev/mapper/$origin_real")
    sync
    umount "$mount_dir"
    dmsetup remove "$snapshot_map"
    dmsetup suspend "$origin_map"
    dmsetup reload "$origin_map" --table "0 $sectors snapshot-merge /dev/mapper/$origin_real $cow_loop P 8"
    dmsetup resume "$origin_map"
    count=0
    while :; do
        status=$(dmsetup status "$origin_map")
        used=$(printf '%s\n' "$status" | awk '{split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')
        test "$used" = 16 && break
        count=$((count + 1))
        if test "$count" -ge 60; then
            printf 'snapshot merge did not complete: %s\n' "$status" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        sleep 1
    done
    dmsetup suspend "$origin_map"
    dmsetup reload "$origin_map" --table "0 $sectors snapshot-origin /dev/mapper/$origin_real"
    dmsetup resume "$origin_map"
    losetup -d "$cow_loop"
    rm -f "$active_file" "$cow_file"
    mount "/dev/mapper/$origin_map" "$mount_dir"
    printf 'rolled back snapshot %s\n' "$label"
}

show_status() {
    printf 'mount='; findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,TARGET "$mount_dir"
    printf 'snapshot='; if test -f "$active_file"; then cat "$active_file"; else printf 'none\n'; fi
    dmsetup status "$origin_map"
    if dmsetup info "$snapshot_map" >/dev/null 2>&1; then dmsetup status "$snapshot_map"; fi
}

case "${1:-}" in
    create) create_snapshot "${2:-}" ;;
    rollback) rollback_snapshot ;;
    status) show_status ;;
    *) printf 'usage: %s {create [label]|rollback|status}\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
